featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Kaizad Patel — what can I say? There truly aren’t enough words to encapsulate the sumptuous wedding food he prepared for our reception. The experience was nothing short of unforgettable.

From the very beginning, Kaizad was accessible, professional, and instinctively understood exactly what a wedding crowd would love — from the starters right through to the main course. He is a culinary genius with an extraordinary eye for detail.

The care, precision, and attention to detail were evident not only in the flavours but also in the service and presentation. Every dish was served with clockwork timing, thoughtfulness, and respect for the occasion. The coordination, calm service flow, and seamless execution made guests feel truly looked after.

The patra nu macchi was absolutely delectable — with the perfect balance of spice and sweetness in the chutney, beautifully wrapped and steamed in a banana leaf. The pulao daal had just the right thickness, wholesomeness, and warmth. The sali jardalu(apricot) chicken was rich, comforting, and perfectly textured. The lagan nu custard was nutty, gently cinnamony, and deeply satisfying. One can go
on..

A particularly thoughtful touch was the bhonas, which were sent promptly between 2–4 pm on the day of our reception to guests who were unwell or unable to attend. That level of care meant so much, and everyone who ate his food had a truly memorable experience.

The thali selection was outstanding and thoughtfully inclusive for vegetarian and Jain guests. Having undhiyu available in winter was a rare and wonderful treat, and the overall spread was exceptional. In fact, a few people told us they came to the wedding especially for his food — which says it all!

Kaizad also caters for Navroz, weddings, and other festive occasions. If you’re looking for unforgettable wedding or festive catering, his cuisine is simply unmatched.

We had Gaurav Caterers for our cocktail and engagement function — and I can truly say, they made the evening magical. Since ours was a love marriage, we had guests coming in from all over — Mangalore, Gujarat, Mumbai, Assam — each with their own tastes and food preferences. But the way Gaurav Caterers designed the menu and brought it to life was simply beautiful.

The spread had the perfect mix of veg and non-veg dishes — each one full of flavour, served hot, and presented so thoughtfully. From starters to desserts, there was something for everyone. People kept going back for seconds (and thirds!) — and even today, weeks later, friends and family still talk about “that incredible food.”

But more than just the food, it was the warmth and care in their service that stood out. Saba, their head manager and Abhay the owner, was a dream to work with — calm, attentive, and truly invested in making sure everything ran smoothly. They made sure we didn’t have to lift a finger, and that meant a lot on such an emotional day.

This was also the first time both sides of our family were meeting — and the food genuinely brought everyone together. It wasn’t just a meal, it was an experience filled with laughter, warmth, and connection. In a way, the food helped build a bridge between two worlds — and that’s something we’ll always be grateful for.

Thank you, Gaurav Caterers, for making our special day not just memorable, but deeply meaningful.

featured_reviews.name: Celina Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Unprofessional and Unreliable

I dislike the fact that I have to give him one star too... I had contacted this caterer a week in advance to place an order for an important event. He called to confirm the order, provided a quote, and everything was finalized. However, his WhatsApp message suddenly disappeared, and it turned out he hadn’t even noted down the order.

When I followed up a day before the event to reconfirm, he first says, your order is tomorrow and you call today to place it? When i told him my order was placed a week back, he claimed that no such communication had taken place since he didn’t have any messages from me. Thankfully, I had taken a screenshot of our conversation, which I showed him. Instead of acknowledging the mistake, he began shouting angrily and falsely accused me of “always doing this” — even though this was my first time ordering from him.

He then canceled the order last minute, saying he didn’t want to take it on anymore.

This experience was extremely stressful and disappointing. The order was for an important event and last minute arrangements had to be done because of his carelessness. The lack of professionalism, the dishonesty, and the aggressive behavior makes it clear that this is not a reliable service provider. He clearly doesn't know how to run a business. I would strongly advise others to be cautious when confirming orders or consider alternative caterers.
